notablePrerequisites:
Dual Casting attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness.
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {R}.
description:
Cast Ancestral Recall by paying {U}.
Holding priority, activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding {R}.
Activate the creature with Dual Casting attached by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Ancestral Recall.
Resolve the copy of Ancestral Recall, causing you to draw three cards.
Activate Mind over Matter twice by discarding two cards, untapping the mana-producing permanent and the creature with Dual Casting attached.
Repeat from step 2.
